I answered Dana in a thread on their message in #north-team: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **IT ticket #4092**.

That comes from #north-random, a channel Dana is in. Ilse posted there yesterday (Oct 13, 11:55) that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub. In my reply I also passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

Earlier this morning, Dana mentioned a ticket number in a private message to me and asked me to keep it to myself. That was only their guess about the future, not the real ticket, so I didn't mention it in the channel.
